summary: Iteration 74 - Testing Chat, Access/Residents, and Orphan Cleanup Features. All 16 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified with all key features working.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console)

critical_code_review_comments: All features properly implemented with correct data-testid attributes for testing
Chat message deletion correctly checks sender_id and read_by array
Conversation hidden_by array properly filters conversations from list
Group member management creates system messages for add/remove actions
Orphan cleanup scans all relevant collections (tasks, boards, children, conversations, residents, members)
seed_data_creation: Tests create and cleanup TEST_ prefixed data automatically
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 74 tested three major fixes: (1) Access/Residents: GET /api/access/residents now includes children and guests tagged as is_resident for the location. POST /api/access/validate also checks children/guests collections. (2) Chat features: DELETE conversation hides via hidden_by array, PUT conversation/members adds/removes with system messages, DELETE message checks sender_id and read_by. Frontend has X button on sidebar items (hover), Trash on own messages (hover), Settings button on group chat header, Edit Group dialog with member list and search. (3) Orphan cleanup: POST /api/admin/cleanup-orphans scans tasks assignees, boards tagged_members, children parent_ids, conversation participants, residents, and member user_ids.

access_residents_list.notes: Returns residents from residents collection + children/guests with is_resident=true

access_validate.notes: Checks residents collection, children, and guests for is_resident flag

orphan_cleanup.notes: Scans and removes orphaned references from tasks, boards, children, conversations, residents, members

conversation_delete.notes: Adds user to hidden_by array, conversation filtered from list

message_delete.notes: Deletes own unread messages only, returns 403 for others' messages, 400 for read messages

frontend_delete_conv_btn.notes: X button appears on hover, data-testid='delete-conv-btn'

frontend_delete_msg_btn.notes: Trash icon for own messages, data-testid='delete-msg-{id}'

frontend_edit_group_dialog.notes: Shows members with remove button, search to add new members
